newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bakrie says to sell PT Indocopper stake.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie says to sell PT Indocopper stake.

text.p: Indonesian conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers said on Wednesday it had decided to sell its 49 percent stake in PT Indocopper Investama Corp, which has a 9.36 percent stake in PT Freeport Indonesia.

"Herewith we invite...for an explanation of the decision by Bakrie & Brothers Board of Directors to sell its 49 percent stakeholding in PT Indocopper Investama Corporation (IIC)," Bakrie said in a statement faxed to Reuters.
The news conference is scheduled for Thursday at 0600 GMT.
PT Nusamba Mineral Industri announced on Wednesday a tender offer to buy a 50.479-percent stake in PT Indocopper for $311.8 million.
